build_order: interface (ingress controller, broadcast stream endpoint, correlation filter)

surfaces.name: ingress-packet-endpoint
operations: POST ingress packet of 1Hz telemetry samples (non-blocking, backpressured); append validated/VALIDATION_FAILED samples and revisions
surfaces.traced_from: context-map: external -> Telemetry Ingestion (Conformist); invariants of Telemetry Ingestion

surfaces.name: validated-event-consumer
operations: receive TelemetrySampleValidated, TelemetrySampleValidationFailed, TelemetryBackfillReordered, TelemetryRevisionAppended and buffer them into windows
surfaces.traced_from: context-map: Telemetry Ingestion -> Telemetry Stream Distribution (published language)

surfaces.name: window-broadcast-stream-endpoint
operations: GET streaming subscription to TelemetryWindowBroadcast events under demand-driven backpressure
surfaces.traced_from: context-map: Telemetry Stream Distribution -> external (PulseStream Engine consumers)

packages.ingestion.domain: TelemetrySample, SensorMetricBoundary rules, ValidationStatus, ingestion events
packages.ingestion.infrastructure: R2DBC append-only record/revision adapter, audit adapter

module_layout.integration: Ingestion publishes versioned events through an application port; Distribution consumes them via an in-process bounded reactive bus (same deployable, out-of-process boundary is the downstream consumers of the broadcast stream).

persistence.storage_paradigm: Relational, append-only time-series records with revision history; PostgreSQL dialect in production
data_model: telemetry_record (append-only raw sample: device_id, metric, t_device, t_ingress, value, validation_status, payload retained)
telemetry_revision (append-only revision of a sample for corrections/backfills: record identity, revision number, value, reason)
audit_trail (append-only: actor, action, outcome, timestamp, correlation_id)
queries: lookup latest revision by (device, metric, t_device) for dedup and correction
ordered read by t_device within reorder window
persistence.migration_plan: Flyway expand-only scripts under classpath:db/migration; runner enabled in base application.yml with distinct JDBC and R2DBC URL placeholders; H2 only in test profile
persistence.backup_recovery: Append-only history is the source of truth; recovery by database snapshots/PITR of the production store
open_questions: Dedup identity: (device, metric, t_device) with value EXCLUDED from identity; a distinct revision discriminator (payload hash / sequence) separates a value correction from a retry; at-least-once inbound assumed
Packets later than the 60s Backfill Reorder Window: planned as appended revision flagged late (pending operator confirmation)
Ranges for ground contact time, respiration, swim stroke unspecified: no boundary check; swim pace only lower bound >45 sec/100m

observability.correlation_key: requestId (WebFilter adopts/generates, carried in Reactor Context and passed explicitly into every audit record; correlation lives only there, not in log-line MDC)

audit_trail.sink: append-only audit_trail table via expand-only migration

observability.tag_policy: bounded enumerations only; never deviceId or other identifiers

export.logs: ECS JSON lines to a local rolling file sink (logging.file.name, logging.structured.format.file=ecs, rolling size/history in config); shipped by the platform (Filebeat/Elastic Agent)
export.metrics: Micrometer via actuator; scrape endpoint only if later named; no push
export.runtime_dependency: none - boot test passes with Elasticsearch/Prometheus absent

risks: Delivery posture and retry-vs-correction identity unstated: value-excluded identity with revision discriminator chosen; both resend classes need test duties
Behavior for packets beyond the 60s reorder window unspecified
Unbounded buffers/blocking I/O forbidden: window buffers and reorder buffers must be bounded and configured
Fan-out sinks must use onBackpressureBuffer(capacity,false) to survive subscriber disconnects
Distribution context may merge into Ingestion (low confidence); kept separate with in-process bus
Device authentication unspecified; security required, spec to decide
